idea-plugin.name: Refactor Simulator
idea-plugin.description:
Preview a refactoring's full impact before it touches your code. Refactor Simulator runs a rename on an in-memory copy, using the IDE's own refactoring engine, and shows the impact, the validation results and a side-by-side diff. Nothing is written until you click Apply to Disk.

Free

  • Simulate a rename in Java and Kotlin, from the editor's context menu or the Refactor menu.
  • Impact Summary: files affected, total changes, imports and references.
  • Validation Report: code parsed, imports resolved, naming collisions and compilation conflicts.
  • Native side-by-side diff, then Apply to Disk or Discard. Discard leaves the project exactly as it was.
  • Related Tests: every test file that references the renamed code.
  • Deterministic: every number comes from Find Usages and the platform's refactoring processors, with no confidence scores or guesswork.

Refactor Simulator Pro (paid, with a free trial)

  • Run the related tests before you apply: each test runs against an isolated copy of the project with the simulated change applied, and the real project is never touched. Gradle projects run only the owning test class through the Gradle Tooling API; Maven projects run through your Maven installation or the one bundled with IntelliJ IDEA.
  • Simulate Extract Variable: select an expression, and see the new variable, the impact and the diff before anything is written.

Simulating Extract Variable was free before version 2026.3.0. Any installation that runs version 2026.3.0 or later before November 2, 2026 keeps it without a license.
